name: Sakagami Yukiko
source:
A girl who lives in a village near Yatara Hot Spring Village. She is Yukio's elder sister.

She knows Yukie, Kanoko, and Chitose. She is a chubby girl who looks good in her school uniform.

In fact, she seems to have a certain secret...

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokunatsu.html]official site[/url]]
